verification.summary: All 191 unittest tests passed, including provider retry bounds, request sampling, privacy, and conditional-retry denominator checks. The Pages build passed using a private output directory. The measured after phase completed in 66.1 seconds; all seven documents used exactly one HTTP attempt and one pipeline call, so live retry recovery was not exercised. Retry behavior is covered by offline transport tests. No private PDF text or model response is committed.
